warnings: axfL (with wfL, gfL) can slide 16.0 mm (-axis -y) until wfL touches wfR; after 9.4 mm it comes out of the motor motfL's output (the drive is lost). Only the friction of the cross fit holds it there. Add a bush or stop so it cannot travel that far.

gfL (on axfL) can slide 16.0 mm (-axis -y) until wfL touches wfR; after 7.0 mm it is out of mesh with igaL and the drive stops. Only the friction of the cross fit holds it. Close the gap with a bush or move a part so it stops the cluster.

axfR (with wfR, gfR) can slide 16.0 mm (+axis +y) until wfR touches wfL; after 9.4 mm it comes out of the motor motfR's output (the drive is lost). Only the friction of the cross fit holds it there. Add a bush or stop so it cannot travel that far.

gfR (on axfR) can slide 16.0 mm (+axis +y) until wfR touches wfL; after 7.0 mm it is out of mesh with igaR and the drive stops. Only the friction of the cross fit holds it. Close the gap with a bush or move a part so it stops the cluster.
raxr cluster has 8.0 mm of axial play (free +4.0 / -4.0 mm): gears and wheels on it wander and rub
